properties.site-address: St Paul's Catholic Academy, Doddington Drive, Cramlington
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: School site identified as surplus and available for redevelopment following recent closure. The land is occupied by the former school buildings and an associated bungalow for a caretaker, all to be cleared prior to redevelopment. It is limited to the brownfield aspect of the site, excluding the adjacent playing fields. Permission has been granted for the demolition aspect of the works (18/00376/DEMGDO). In 2019 an application has been permitted for building of 19 homes once cleared (16/03567/FUL). With the loss of the existing bungalow, the proposal will result in 18 net additional homes on completion. Scheme is now underway and forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
